caseName: Ohio ex rel. Thompson v. Industrial Commission
caseNameFull: Ohio ex rel. Thompson v. Industrial Commission of Ohio
attorneys: Mr. Paul V. Connolly for appellant. Mr. Thomas J. Herbert, Attorney General of Ohio, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want *783of a properly presented federal question. Live Oak Water Users’ Association v. Railroad Commission, 269 U. S. 354, 358-59; Ohio ex rel. Squire v. Brown, 312 U. S. 652.

Mr. Paul V. Connolly for appellant. Mr. Thomas J. Herbert, Attorney General of Ohio, for appellee.
